state_codes_are: Application identifiers, not an assertion of ISO/LGD coding
refresh_policy: Recheck substantive changes before review_due. No scheduler is installed by this pack.
coverage: All states/UTs have directory or explicit fallback records. Local procedures are partial; no route is certified for execution. Each asset routes only from its own selected state; where a state has no verified procedure, an honest state-specific fallback is shown instead of another state's steps.
